_note: Tunable rules. Invariants (Spent, no mid-turn reshuffle, triggers fire once, no card creation) are engine code, not settings here. All numbers are placeholders.

cost._how: clause weight = verb.weight + verb.amountScale * amount * hits + target.weight + condition.weight + trigger.weight. A clause that hurts you (or helps an enemy) counts drawbackFactor times its weight. Card cost = round(sum), never below 0. X amounts spend all remaining energy on top.

combatEdits._how: Quick edits in a fight: one tap, applied at once, no clipboard. They last until the fight ends.
